newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Malaysian crude palmoil futures, physicals and palm kernel oil futures markets are closed today for the Christmas holiday.

On Tuesday, Prices ended mixed after a quiet trading day as interest remained lacking because of the Christmas holiday. Lack of fresh leads also dampened the market which is waiting for the December 1-25 palm oil export data. Traders said prices are likely to hold steady at around current lewvels due to the underlying firm fundamentals. March futures closed four ringgit up at 1,229 ringgit ($486.35) a tonne.
